note: Plaid setts the cloth shader draws (ClothMaterials.pattern_spec, cloth.gdshader pat_kind 2): our own designs, not registered or clan tartans. A sett is a list of [palette token or #hex, width] stripes, the widths relative (thread counts); symmetric = the list runs from pivot to pivot and is mirrored (the full repeat is the list and then its inner stripes back); scale_m = the full repeat in metres. A catalog zone or a look names one ('sett': 'hill_green') or gives its own list.

hill_green.label: Hill green
hill_green.note: A dark green ground, a broad blue band between black bars, a fine yellow line at the pivot.

madder_red.label: Madder red
madder_red.note: A madder red ground crossed by green and dark blue bands, a white line at the pivot.

drab_hodden.label: Drab and brown
drab_hodden.note: Undyed drab with walnut brown bands and a butternut line: a working plaid of country dyes.

grey_blue.label: Grey and blue
grey_blue.note: Kersey blue and slate grey, black bars, a white line.

shepherd.label: Shepherd's check
shepherd.note: Small black-and-white check of equal stripes.
